description: List paginated messages from an inbox folder
behaviors: Whitelists folder parameter: unread, processed, or failed
Enforces pagination bounds: limit 1-100 (default 50), offset >= 0
Returns messages array with total count for pagination
Validates inbox exists before listing

description: Rotate inbox HMAC secret and return new secret in plaintext
behaviors: Increments inbox secretVersion
Previous secret version remains valid for 24-hour overlap period
Returns new secret and version in response body
Logs rotation event to audit log
securityNotes: New secret returned in plaintext exactly once — store immediately, it cannot be retrieved again
Requires manage_org permission (elevated access)

description: Get disk and send quota usage for current namespace
behaviors: Returns disk usage in bytes and MB with quota
Returns send count with daily quota and reset time (midnight UTC)
Defaults: 500MB disk, 1000 sends/day via env vars

description: Return unread email counts per inbox for UI badge display
behaviors: Counts JSON files in unread/ subfolder for each inbox
Returns counts object keyed by inbox ID plus total

description: Validate unsubscribe token and suppress email address
behaviors: Validates JWT token containing email, namespace, org, outboundId
Adds suppression record to email-suppression.jsonl
Returns success message with email address
Logs unsubscribe event to audit log
securityNotes: No authentication required — rate-limited only
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP
Tokens are single-use and time-bounded
Uses leftmost IP from x-forwarded-for header (can be spoofed)

description: CORS preflight support for unsubscribe endpoint
behaviors: Returns 204 with CORS headers for POST and OPTIONS

description: Validate resubscribe token and remove email suppression
behaviors: Validates JWT token containing email, namespace, org
Removes suppression only for soft_bounce, unsubscribe, manual reasons
Hard bounce suppressions cannot be removed via resubscribe
Returns success if suppression removed, error if not suppressed
Logs resubscribe event to audit log
securityNotes: No authentication required — rate-limited only
Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per IP
Tokens are single-use and time-bounded
Uses leftmost IP from x-forwarded-for header (can be spoofed)

description: CORS preflight support for resubscribe endpoint
behaviors: Returns 204 with CORS headers for POST and OPTIONS

description: Return email reputation status with bounce/complaint rates and thresholds
behaviors: Returns status: healthy, warning, paused, or suspended
Includes bounce rate, complaint rate, sent counts (7d, 30d)
Returns threshold values for warning/paused/suspended states
Org-level suspension overrides evaluation status

description: Return daily reputation metrics over time
behaviors: Query parameter: days (default 30, max 90)
Returns history array with daily metrics

description: Process unread emails and fire configured chain triggers
behaviors: Processes inboxes in parallel
Atomically claims emails to prevent double-processing
Fires chain run for each claimed email
Moves emails to processed/failed based on result
Returns counts: processed, skipped, errors array
securityNotes: Uses minimal auth marker (email-processor=true cookie) when invoking chain run

description: Receive inbound webhook emails from external providers
behaviors: Validates content-length header (max 25MB)
Checks disk quota before processing (rejects with 507 if exceeded)
Extracts namespace from header, body, query param, or env
Auth varies by provider: Resend HMAC-SHA256, Postmark HMAC token, SendGrid ECDSA (not implemented), Haraka/custom bearer token
Rate-limits auth failures: 5 failures in 5 min = 1hr IP block
Supports 24h secret version overlap for rotation
Normalizes email to internal format, blocks attachments in v1
Writes to disk and logs to audit trail
Failed emails (quota, auth) logged to rejected.jsonl
securityNotes: Resend: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification via x-svix-signature header
Postmark: HMAC token comparison via x-postmark-signature header
SendGrid: ECDSA signature verification NOT implemented in v1 (accepts all)
Haraka: Bearer token (HMAC-derived secret or HARAKA_API_KEY env var)
Custom: Bearer token (HMAC-derived secret with version overlap)
Auth failure rate limiting: 5 failures in 5 minutes triggers 1-hour IP block
IP-based rate limiting uses x-forwarded-for leftmost IP (spoofable)

behaviors: Detects mode: resend, auth, relay, or none
Returns configured status, host, port, masked user
Shows inbound email status when TENANT_ID and SMTP_FROM domain match
securityNotes: Masks SMTP username (shows first 3 chars + ***)

description: Send test email to verify SMTP configuration
behaviors: Requires 'to' field in request body
Sends test email with fixed subject and body
Uses nodemailer for delivery (optional dependency)
Returns success or SMTP error message
securityNotes: Requires manage_org permission (elevated access)
Sends real email to specified address
